verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a DevSecOps SaaS/self-managed platform like GitLab, but the evidence pack documents no retention policies, deletion controls, or data lifecycle settings. The closest items are self-hosting (a user-side arrangement) and editing an input to remove a detected secret (an adjacent feature), and neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
